title: Construction or operation?
hook: The railway opens. What proves trains kept running?

knows: Selected accounts can describe distinct institutions and dated changes.

claims.text: Field’s military retrospective separates Haifa–Beirut construction and traffic opening from the later Beirut–Tripoli gap closure, ceremony and recorded military/wheat traffic. These dates describe different sections and acts. A completed track or ceremony is not a passenger timetable, uninterrupted civilian service or a sovereignty decision. The colonial military account does not supply everyone’s wartime experience; original operating records remain uncollated.
